title: windows-read-only-trial-package

Real risk service TLS can transiently fail. The operator retains identity for explicit retries and stays fail closed.
Formal Alpha/Windows Service/Explorer release gates remain unchanged.

migration_tool provision_roles, apply_migrations and verified backup
Host local operator, read-only trial and health CLI
